newsitem.title: USA: International Equity proceeds late again.
newsitem.headline: International Equity proceeds late again.

text.p: International Equity Resources Inc said Monday the receipt of funds from the first block of its stock being sold to Kyoto Securities Ltd is now expected by the end of April.
The $500,000 payment was originally due March 20, but was delayed, International Equity announced on March 21.
In February, the company said it would sell a total of 20 million of its 25 million outstanding common shares to Kyoto Securities for $20 million.
International Equity said it was advised by Kyoto Securities that the balance of the first block, $4.5 million, should be received by June 30 as called for in the original stock purchase agreement.
The remaining three blocks of five million shares are scheduled to be purchased by December 31, 1997, June 30, 1998 and December 31, 1998, International Equity said.
